articles.summary: DUBLIN and SHANGHAI, Nov. 11, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PDD Holdings Inc. (“PDD Holdings” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PDD) today announced that it will report its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2025, before U.S. markets open on Tuesday, November 18, 2025.
